mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) combined with high interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, slowing industrial production (INDPRO) relative to demand signals an impending economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with declining INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL (inflation) compresses real consumer purchasing power and forces the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an unsustainable demand surge that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve intervention, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.3% and CPIAUCSL is above 320.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of labor market tightness (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), the economy experiences strong wage growth that erodes corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.
